Name: JP's Farms - Forest Little Farm - Small Farm
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][center][color=#00ff00][u][i][b]Little Forest Farm[/b][/i][/u][/color][/center][/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i]The greatest things anyone can achieve always start from the smallest things.[/i][/b][/size][/color]


[b][i][color=#00ffff][size=6][u]Map Features:[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]A much more compact version of the forest farm.[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Several previously unusable spaces are now available for use.[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Several buildings were relocated to maximize the use of space.[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Several ponds were removed and there is an optional configuration to replace the last one with a crop lot. A pond was added behind the house for irrigation.[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]An optional configuration to add a bridge to the pond to allow crossing it and not having to go around it.[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Plants will grow all over the farm.[/b][/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[b][i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Installation:[/u][/size][/color]
[/i][/b]
[b][size=4]Download the mod, unzip it in the Mods folder of the game. Configure it with the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. Check new mod requirements.
[/size]
